title: LTM Ltd - 540005 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: LTM Q1 FY27 revenue rose 6.4% YoY in constant currency to USD 1,224M, with EBIT margin up 40 bps QoQ to 15.5%.
summary.overview: Revenue was flat QoQ at USD 1,224M (+0.3% CC QoQ, +6.4% CC YoY) while EBIT margin expanded to 15.5%, helped by New Horizons efficiencies and forex offsetting wage hikes. PAT rose 9.5% QoQ to Rs.1,469 Cr, aided by a one-time gain on Voicing.AI. Order book was steady at USD 1.7B including two large deal wins. Management guided growth to accelerate through Q2 and into H2, with FY27 growth expected to beat FY26's roughly 6%, with the delayed India government project and Middle East billing both expected to recover from Q2.

segments.name: Financial Services
segments.commentary: Grew 3.2% QoQ CC after prior decline, but down 2.5% YoY; margin improved QoQ on revenue recovery and utilisation.

segments.name: Technology and Services
segments.commentary: Grew 3.4% QoQ and 10% YoY CC; management said it is now at double-digit YoY growth and is North America-centric.

segments.name: Production
segments.commentary: Fell 5.7% QoQ CC on seasonal pass-through runoff, but grew 5.3% YoY.

segments.name: Consumer
segments.commentary: Declined 0.7% QoQ CC due to delayed India government tax-department ramp-up and hardware shipment issues; grew 18.2% YoY.

guidance_outlook: Growth expected to accelerate through Q2 and into H2 on organic basis, with Q2 organic growth above Q1.
FY27 growth expected to be better than FY26 (~6%); management framed this as base momentum improving further.
Organic EBIT margin expected to keep expanding; management said FY27 margin should not decline versus FY26 after Randstad consolidation.
Randstad Technology & Consulting (Europe and Australia) closing expected end Q2 or early Q3; management advised holding prior financial assumptions for the first quarter post-close.
SG&A expected to remain around current levels, not moving to 11%-11.5% of sales, with QoQ variation possible.
Utilisation target range 86%-87%; freshers to be added at roughly 1,300 per quarter.
risks_watch: India government project ramp-up delayed by memory chip and hardware shipment issues; management expects Q2 recovery but has not factored margin impact.
Geopolitical escalation (Middle East war, energy prices) could delay discretionary spend and Middle East billing.
Randstad integration: consolidation may cause near-term QoQ margin drag; synergies expected over one to two quarters.
Subcontractor share rising (~130 bps QoQ); need to see whether it normalises after vendor consolidation ramp-ups.
Order book constant at USD 1.7B but with price deflation; growth depends on converting to higher-value bookings toward USD 2B.
Dependence on INR weakness for margin support; forex and wage-hike offsets cancelled out this quarter.
summary.management_tone: Confident on margin and deal momentum, with cautious hedging on geopolitics and discretionary spend. Management was consistent that Q1 drags are temporary, but it avoided quantifying Q2 growth or the India ramp size.
key_quotes: Our order book remains strong and broad -based.
The productivity-linked pricing conversations we have had with some of our large clients are now behind us.
So the quarter-on-quarter improvement you can basically attribute to the operational efficiencies that we have been able to drive and that, as I mentioned earlier also is a continuing exercise.
I would sort of propose that, assume what we had shared before as a safe option at this time.

qa_highlights.question: Is the underlying QoQ momentum, adjusted for seasonal pass-through and Middle East headwinds, expected to carry into Q2?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the largest segments are in a growth trajectory and should continue into Q2, barring seasonal effects, the Middle East billing and India ramp-up, and unless geopolitical escalation occurs.

qa_highlights.question: Will SG&A move toward 11%-11.5% of sales?
qa_highlights.answer: Venu Lambu said SG&A should stay stable at current levels; Vipul Chandra said it is not likely to move to 11%-11.5%, though QoQ variation of minor size can occur because of continued sales investment.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Randstad deal's IT business ramp starting before closure, and how will margins be affected?
qa_highlights.answer: Vipul Chandra said the ramp-up of the Randstad IT services component has already started and will ramp from Q2; the consolidation may cause a one to two quarter QoQ margin impact, but management is building a buffer so FY27 margin does not decline versus FY26.

qa_highlights.question: How should the Randstad integration be modelled after closure?
qa_highlights.answer: Venu Lambu said closure is expected by end Q2 or early Q3 and asked investors to assume the previously shared financials as a safe option for now, since transformation activity is limited until approvals are received.

qa_highlights.question: What is the India government project ramp-up timing and margin risk?
qa_highlights.answer: Venu Lambu said the project will ramp up in Q2 with Q2 above Q1, depending on hardware delivery expected early in Q2, with the original schedule to be regained between Q2 and Q3; no margin impact has been factored in for that project.

qa_highlights.question: Will FY27 growth exceed FY26 and what is the ramp of the large deal?
qa_highlights.answer: Venu Lambu said the expectation is that FY27 will be better than FY26's roughly 6% growth, with the large deal transition occupying most of Q2 and ramp-up from Q3 onwards.

capex_capacity: Utilisation excluding trainees 86.4% in Q1 vs 85.7% in Q4; management target range 86%-87% and said the company is in the middle of that range, with QoQ variation possible
Headcount 87,886 at end of Q1; 1,308 freshers added; management expects roughly 1,300 freshers per quarter for the year, with possible acceleration (6,000+ freshers joined last year)
Pyramid shape expected to move from traditional pyramid to a diamond-shaped structure over time
AI 1000 initiative: 1,000+ Forward Deployed Engineers; internal assessment and training cohorts expected between Q2 and Q3, with the initial cohort covering the first two quarters
BlueVerse Studio footprint expanded with a new facility in Bengaluru; 17 unique BlueVerse Voicing implementations in the past 12 months, including two wins this quarter
demand_pricing: Order book stable at USD 1.7B in Q1, including two large deal wins; management said the figure is not like-for-like with last year because of price deflation of about 15% on certain renewed or new scopes, and that it has never let the order book fall

Financial Services grew 3.2% QoQ CC and declined 2.5% YoY; Technology and Services grew 3.4% QoQ and 10% YoY; Production fell 5.7% QoQ on seasonal pass-through runoff and grew 5.3% YoY; Consumer declined 0.7% QoQ and grew 18.2% YoY
Top 5 and Top 10 customers grew 4.5% and 4.3% QoQ; 15 clients in the USD 50M+ bucket (one added YoY) and 52 clients in the USD 20M+ bucket (11 added YoY)
Productivity-linked pricing conversations with large clients described as complete; management said new deals are priced on the new AI-productivity reference point
Middle East is less than 3% of revenue; the India government tax-department project ramp was delayed by memory-chip and hardware shipment issues and is expected to ramp in Q2
AI revenue across Business, Creative and Industrial AI about USD 150M quarterly run rate; Business AI expected to be the largest piece, then Industrial AI, then Creative AI
Subcontractor share up about 130 bps QoQ and about 320 bps YoY, attributed to vendor consolidation deals where tail-vendor resources are transitioned in; expected to normalise over time

adds.what: BlueVerse Studio new facility in Bengaluru
1,000+ Forward Deployed Engineers under AI 1000 initiative (internal training cohorts)

growth.why: Management guides FY27 growth better than FY26's ~6% with Q2 growth above Q1 and India government and Middle East billing recovering from Q2; backing is partial, citing a steady USD 1.7B order book (two large wins, but price deflation of ~15% on some scopes), a Bengaluru BlueVerse facility, and ~1,300 freshers per quarter, with no quantified capacity addition.
